name: Armored apostle form
desc: This body will change form at half health. A lethal hit to this form is not the end of the hunt.

name: Final dragon form
desc: This is the final body. Its defeat exposes only its own stronghold breach.

name: Preparing a hammer sweep
desc: Grunbeld raises his hammer. Leave its reach or break the attack line with stone.

name: Preparing fixed dragonfire
desc: The dragon is braced. The marked path will burn after three seconds; its aim is fixed. Move sideways or behind solid cover.

name: Recovering after dragonfire
desc: The dragon pauses after releasing or interrupting its breath. This is a brief opening to move or counterattack.
